selection.text_only_filters: Same structural text, length, opening-reference and evidence-medium criteria as Phase1; no original claim modification.
selection.class_matching: Not statistically matched; all qualifying article/text-distinct controls up to the fixed maximum. No per-type or per-domain quota.

manual_exclusions.7: Rhetorical questions, deictic references and a quotation are combined without a clearly delimited standalone assertion.
manual_exclusions.13: The absolute wording will stop the spread is stronger than the supplied QA about reducing spread and partial protection.
manual_exclusions.36: The claim can mean Vos personally lost his seat, while the QA explains a Republican party seat loss; scope is ambiguous.
manual_exclusions.57: The claim names Grand Island, Nebraska, but the supplied context is a NY-27 debate and the QA relies on Buffalo-area Grand Island materials; geographical scope is inconsistent.
manual_exclusions.66: The claim names the Nobel-winning World Food Program while the QA concerns the distinct World Food Program USA nonprofit.
manual_exclusions.75: Recently has no explicit comparison period in the standalone text.
manual_exclusions.110: The input is a fact-check article headline evaluating another statement, rather than the underlying standalone claim.
manual_exclusions.113: The sole supplied QA quotes the same Facebook ranking assertion instead of independently establishing a Forbes ranking.
manual_exclusions.123: Same PHE flu/Covid reporting story as frozen Phase1 source index 119; exclude cross-class story overlap even though the article URL differs.
manual_exclusions.144: The October 2020 claim of appointment is mixed with QA about a final selection round and a later appointment; temporal scope is unresolved.
manual_exclusions.146: The opening first-person job statistics do not identify the country or speaker in the standalone input.
manual_exclusions.152: Over thirty million people and the last several months omit the jurisdiction and time interval; standalone scope is unclear.
manual_exclusions.156: The claim attributes specific words to Pence, but the supplied QA verifies the embedded surveillance assertion rather than the quotation.
manual_exclusions.195: The first-person standalone text does not name the country whose population or military rule is being measured.
manual_exclusions.202: The first-person standalone text does not name the country whose population or military rule is being measured.
manual_exclusions.212: The first-person standalone text does not name the country whose population or military rule is being measured.
manual_exclusions.224: The justification says five million while the claim says forty-five million; exclude the internally inconsistent record rather than rewriting its label.
manual_exclusions.235: The claim says GBP3000 while the QA gives a maximum GBP3200 for repeated violations; amount and conditions differ.
manual_exclusions.262: Performed poorly is an evaluative conclusion without a defined threshold in the standalone text.
manual_exclusions.289: The input includes a Fact Check headline and a warning about misinformation; exclude this visible editorial label cue.
manual_exclusions.293: Gruelling is an evaluative characterization; the QA describes exercise routines but supplies no explicit threshold.
manual_exclusions.314: Profound effect on the future is a qualitative forecast, not a clearly delimited factual control.
manual_exclusions.330: The alleged intention to limit voter turnout is stronger than the QA about fewer sites and encouragement of postal voting.
manual_exclusions.342: The input is a Fact Check headline with an explicit Did NOT editorial verdict cue rather than a clean standalone control.
manual_exclusions.459: The claim gives 217 torture and 3661 assault cases, but the QA gives 270 and 3835 for 2018/2019; exact counts and period do not align.
